English Level Test

An adaptive grammar placement test across the full CEFR range (A1–C1) — 75 items in five difficulty bands, drawn from a larger pool each time. Your result comes with the exercises on this site that match it.

Free adaptive English placement test: questions adjust to your level in real time. Instant CEFR result (A1–C1) and matching exercises. No sign-up.

This version is adaptive: after each answer, the next question is chosen to be most informative at your estimated level. You get at least 15 questions, and up to 20 if your estimate is still sitting on a level boundary.

You see no right-or-wrong while you test — a full review with explanations comes at the end. Untimed (the clock only counts up); most people finish in 5–8 minutes. Nothing is submitted unless you ask for extra feedback by email at the end.
